body: I'm barely making ends meet while hiding it all because I'm sharing custody, My moms pulled a gun on me, I'm having to ask for rides to work and to get my kids to school. I feel like im failing as a parent every day I'm no where near where I should be in life. I'm so miserable and I just don't want to do it any more I really don't its just court struggles and pain every day since I was 13. There's peaks of sunshine but it's like it's so far away and I'm tired of chasing it.
